steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the buildup of armed forces and arms races among the great powers  
2. Alliance systems – tangled defense pacts (e.g. Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance)  
3. Nationalism – aggressive national pride and minority‐group tensions in multiethnic empires
